Document.title: Regional airport
Document.p: Build under Civic at 50% technology. Cost $180,000, footprint 6 by 6. Connect any side to dirt track, road or rail. Each operating day needs 60 labor, 30 water, 200 low-voltage electricity and 20 goods, and produces 4 waste. Upkeep is $30 per day even when idle. A fully supplied day earns $60 in service receipts, listed under Service revenue. Flights arrive from beyond the map and depart when the airport is operating. Flying planes are a visual representation of this activity. Airports add pollution. Jobs are represented by labor demand.
Select the building to check inventory and input shortages. Use warehouses and markets for supplies, and keep waste moving to disposal.
